title: Text: DET Matt Boyd ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hope you and the fam are doing well. I’m working on a story about how the shutdown is impacting people in the org - players, coaches, executives, broadcasters, etc. - and what a typical day is like for you guys now. If you have any time to talk, let me know. Won’t take long.
Will do Anthony, sounds good. Let me know when
My bad, I didn’t see you called. Can I try you at 6:30?
Actually just sitting down for dinner! Is this article for tomorrow? Or can we talk tomorrow
Tomorrow works great. I’ll touch base then
